title: Tbilisi’s Rike Concert Hall Slated for Demolition Despite Never Opening
summary: The Rike Concert Hall in Tbilisi, Georgia, is set to be demolished. Designed by the renowned Italian architects Massimiliano and Doriana Fuksas of Studio Fuksas, the building was mostly completed in 2012 but has never been opened. summary: On July 19, Cuban artist and dissident Luis Manuel Otero Alcántara arrived in Miami after a period when his whereabouts remained unknown following his release from Guanajay Prison.
